title: Water Advisory — Final Confirmation from City of Toledo

fields.fromName: City of Toledo Department of Public Utilities (Critical Facilities Desk)
fields.subject: FW: Do Not Drink Advisory — Final Status and Next Steps
fields.note: This is the official update from the City of Toledo Department of Public Utilities on the Do Not Drink advisory. We are confirming that two consecutive clean sample sets, 24 hours apart, are required before lifting the advisory. The first set was collected at 08:00. We expect no earlier than Sunday evening for the advisory to be lifted. We will issue a flushing instruction after confirmation. Hospitals should plan for the advisory to remain in effect through Sunday.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the extended duration of the advisory. The AOC must now plan for sustained operations under Level 2 for at least 36 hours, with pre-defined thresholds for service reduction and patient transfer. Watch for the team to assess tank consumption and begin contingency planning.
